# Haven Locksmith

> Licensed and insured locksmith serving Nassau and Suffolk counties on Long Island, NY. Home, car, and commercial locksmith work, with same-day service and free estimates.

- Phone: (516) 555-0142
- Email: info@havenlocksmith.com
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

## Services

- [Home Lockout Service](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/home-lockout-service/): Locked out of your house or apartment? A technician gets you back inside without damaging the door or the lock.
- [Car Lockout Service](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/car-lockout-service/): Keys locked in the car? We unlock most vehicles without scratching the paint or damaging the door.
- [Lock Rekeying](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/lock-rekeying/): Moved in, lost a key, or changed roommates? Rekeying makes old keys stop working without replacing the lock.
- [Lock Installation](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/lock-installation/): Worn, broken, or outdated locks replaced with new hardware that fits your door and your budget.
- [Deadbolt Installation](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/deadbolt-installation/): Reinforced deadbolts and strike plates that make entry doors much harder to kick in or force.
- [Smart Lock Installation](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/smart-lock-installation/): Keypad and Wi-Fi smart locks installed, paired, and tested so you can stop carrying keys.
- [Safe Installation](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/safe-installation/): Home and business safes delivered, anchored, and set up so they stay put and stay locked.
- [Car Key Replacement](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/car-key-replacement/): Lost every key or only have one? We cut and program replacement car keys, including transponder keys, on site.
- [Key Fob Programming](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/key-fob-programming/): Dead, lost, or new key fobs and remotes programmed to your vehicle at your location.
- [Ignition Repair](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/ignition-repair/): Key won't turn, stuck in the ignition, or worn out? Ignition cylinders repaired or replaced on site.
- [Master Key Systems](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/master-key-systems/): One master key for managers and separate keys for each tenant, office, or door.
- [Panic Bar Installation](https://bg-guy.github.io/locksmith/panic-bar-installation/): Panic bars and exit devices installed and adjusted so emergency exits open with one push.
